page.layout: One printed page. Running text in one column; marginal notes in the left margin (small italic catchphrases) and a few in the right margin. Page number at top left. Running head at top centre. Catchword-free; a bullet-like mark at the foot.
page.notes: Transcription of this dense 16th-century Latin page was not completed reliably. The printed text runs from "Iamque condemnatus erucem quam manu tenebat, in altum erexit, & a curia papae" through to "Cardi-" at the foot, with marginal notes including "Veramel. Inform.", "Walter Ca-", "Rog. Inform.", and "Norberus." This transcription is incomplete and should be redone from the scan.
